title: Supplier Radar — shared canonical definitions
description: Shared $defs for canonical contracts v0.2.0 (P1-001B). Mapping rules: docs/domain/DATA_MAPPING.md. Value validity that the source can violate is expressed as data-quality flags, not schema rejection; the schema only rejects structurally impossible records.

uuid.description: Deterministic UUIDv5 under namespace 9a58f195-b16e-554c-b016-5a636976af05 (= UUIDv5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'urn:supplier-radar:canonical')). Name templates in DATA_MAPPING.md §3.

source_key.description: Organizer identifier kept as a string (lot_id, procedure_id). Observed numeric; never cast to int.

inn.description: INN as delivered (outer whitespace trimmed only). Malformed values are preserved and flagged INVALID_INN_FORMAT; never cast to int.

kpp.description: KPP as delivered or null when empty. Never part of identity. Non-9-char-format values are kept and flagged INVALID_KPP_FORMAT.

decimal_string.description: Non-negative decimal as a string (Decimal semantics, never float business logic).

platform.description: Normalized from is_eshop_or_aisgz: 'АИС ГЗ' -> AIS_GZ, 'ЭМ' -> EM. Any other value = structurally invalid (quarantine).

okpd2_code.description: Normalized OKPD2 code: XX | XX.X | XX.XX | XX.XX.X | XX.XX.XX | XX.XX.XX.X{1,3}.

dataset.description: notices_24_25 = Извещения_24-25.csv · suppliers_24_25 = Поставщики_24-25.csv · items_24_25 = ТРУ_24-25.csv

row_number.description: 1-based data-row number in the source file (header excluded); joins to the raw record store (BR-31).
